ownerMessages: 修正挥手动作中掌心显示过白，然后将鞠躬致谢动作上线

visualReview.scope: Whole-sequence light/dark contact overviews for wave and bow; actual browser canvas overviews and 320px dialog; native raised-palm frame 48 before/after correction.
visualReview.notClaimed: Not a full-resolution manual inspection of every frame, not an independent reviewer approval, and not physical-device delivery of every 24fps sample.
visualReview.paletteCorrection: 54 whole-frame PNGs: bounded palm-side warm RGB correction only; exact alpha and all pixels outside the mask preserved before WebP encoding.
visualReview.compressionDisclosure: Quality-92 RGB compression may change small color values outside the correction mask; alpha remains exact. Per-action opaque RGB mean error is bounded by 3 levels.
visualReview.knownAcceptedVariation: Original owner-accepted wave retains its short provider-generated blink. Bow reuses the previously rejected nod trial under the explicitly authorized meaning thanks, not head-only nod.
visualReview.bowTiming: Consecutive source indices 24 through 96 at 24fps; surplus neutral lead/tail removed; runtime endpoints are the canonical original-derived resting pose.

tests.unrelatedExperimentDisclosure: The untracked local Cubism ownership trial has an existing frozen-source hash mismatch; it was not included in the release or changed to make this release pass.
tests.isolatedWebpackBuild: passed; no production database connection; existing missing-DATABASE_URL admin prerender diagnostic retained and disclosed

workflow: Retain original video bytes, embedded AIGC identifiers and losslessly decoded original PNG sequences.
Use prepare-kling-matte.py --action nod for the authorized bow source; the black-matte algorithm is source-specific and does not approve a new character.
Use correct-kling-palm.py only after explicit palette-edit authorization; preserve all alpha, geometry and outside-mask PNG pixels.
Use package-kling-gestures.mjs: fixed crop and uniform scale, immutable hash-bound static atlases, native 24fps, no interpolation or limb composites.
Verify every runtime pose and actual asset hash in the browser, then back up and replace only the application container. Retain database, uploads, credentials, proxy and the rollback image.
A new source, palette mask, crop or packaging result invalidates the old visual and browser approval scopes.
